sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout returned 12 current-week candidates across llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; the first three were already present in known-links/items, so the run pivoted within the same table to Model Forensics.
Full 86-page PDF was extracted and read; article covers protocol, environment design, six case studies, evidence tables, limitations, and agent-safety implications.
arXiv metadata, OpenReview workshop version, GitHub environment/reproduction repositories, and Hugging Face rollout dataset were checked; no image localization was needed.
